nature: REGISTERED method-track protocol. Frozen Reader adapters G_5 and G_100 (and G_1 if the GPU allotment allows) read a guidance bundle whose facts and candidates come from the frozen LLM Parser's parse instead of the structural parse. No training, no new adapter, no prompt change; only the bundle source changes. Reuse of the official MultiTQ test split; selection on dev only.
question: Does building the Reader's bundle from the Parser's parse (the more rewording-robust front end) make the frozen Reader lose less Hits@1 under R3 rewording, and score higher on R3 rewrites, than the same frozen Reader on the structural bundle (G_k), at each fitting level, without more than 0.3 points of dev-original loss?

method.name: GR_k (Parser-grounded Reader) at level k in {k05_s0 (5%), k100 (100%)}; k01_s0 (1%) optional (GPU-hour cap)
method.reader: FROZEN G_k adapter, unchanged: k05_s0 guided/adapters/G_k05_s0_ordS_s0/ep2 (sha256 5adfc273...), k100 G_k100_ordS_s0/ep1 (ee08faf1...), k01_s0 G_k01_s0_ordS_s0/ep2 (4d81d7a0...); Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, vLLM 0.10.2 (tkgqa-vllm:latest), the frozen gk_infer LLM arguments (bf16, enable_lora, max_lora_rank 16, max_loras 1, max_model_len 2304, seed 0, CUDA graphs), gpu_memory_utilization 0.40 (llm_controls LC1-A1 / R3 arms), greedy temperature 0, max 48 new tokens, seed 0, frozen chat template and date_string; prompt = gk_common.g_user of the normalised bundle, order S, gk_common.fit_g_prompt 2,048-token cap; answer validity gk_common.canon_answer; ranked list = gk_common.g_ranked(answer, Parser-pool S seed-0 top-50) (G_k: answer + S_k seed-0 list)
method.parser: FROZEN P_k generations, cached (no Parser inference is re-run): checkpoint k01_s0 ep3, k05_s0 ep1, k100 ep0.5 (the P_k selected checkpoints); files parser/raw/<k>/raw_P_{dev_sel2000,test}_<ckpt>.jsonl.gz, robustness_r3/llm/P/raw (R3 rewrites + dev paraphrases), robustness/P/raw (R1), robustness_r2/P/raw (R2)

bundle_sources.PALONE (GR-A_k): kpct_executor.compact_to_parse(c, q, structural_parse=None): the Parser hypothesis only (one relation, one entity per mention, the Parser's qtype / answer type / granularity / time / order / anchor) = structural-ablation mode PALONE
bundle_sources.PK (GR-K_k): kpct_executor.compact_to_parse(c, q, structural_parse=the row's frozen structural bundle parse): the frozen P_k parse = Parser hypothesis first, then the deduplicated structural alternatives (<= 5 relations; <= 5 alternatives per mention)

method.bundle_construction: gr_build.py: validation exactly as frozen pk_execute.work (pk_common.extract_json + validate_compact; check_names); execution exactly as kpct_executor.Executor.execute(probs='classifier') of the level's executor (rec_info_from_parse, the k% classifier probabilities of the parse's choices, anchor_mention override, build_info with the frozen operators / retrieval / RULE ordering, pool cap 1,000, the 3 S_k LightGBM seeds); bundle = kpct_core.parse_json(rec, info) + kpct_core.bundle_core(o, rec, S seed-0 scores), i.e. the frozen code that built every G_k bundle. Field by field: candidates = top-20 distinct pool candidates in S seed-0 order (Ranker seed 0 over the Parser candidates); 'RULE rank' = the candidate's position in the RULE-ordered pool of the Parser parse (the Rules pipeline's procedure applied to the Parser hypothesis); 'S score' = Ranker seed-0 score; 'satisfies operator' = the pool's sat_any flag; supporting facts = kpct_core.cand_support (<= 3) mapped to the 20 provenance facts of mtq_export.provenance_facts (S seed-0 order); operator trace = kpct_core.operator_trace on the Parser pool; parse block = the Parser parse rendered by the frozen render_parse (probabilities are not rendered). No field is missing; template_unseen is set to null (not rendered, as rob_build for rewrites).
method.fallback: As P_k (tau off): invalid_json / unknown_name (both sources), execution error / invalid execution / empty pool (source-specific) -> the row keeps the frozen G_k output (Reader on the structural bundle), mirroring P_k's fallback to S_k. Fallback rates are reported per split.
method.prompt_identity_reuse: If the rendered G user turn of the Parser-grounded bundle equals that of the row's frozen structural bundle (string equality of gk_common.g_user; identical text => identical token ids and truncation), the frozen G_k answer of that row is reused instead of regenerating (exact up to vLLM batch numerics; the frozen output IS the frozen adapter's greedy output on that prompt); the ranked-list tail is the Parser-pool S seed-0 list. Only prompt-different rows are generated. I2 (gold-free, descriptive): at most 150 dev ORIG + 150 DEV_ACCEPTED prompt-identical rows per level (default_rng([20261118, 11]) / ([20261118, 12])) are regenerated from the frozen structural bundles and their top-1 agreement with the frozen G_k outputs is reported.

identity_checks_gold_free.I1a: PK-source S seed-b top-50 lists (fallback rows: S_k's own list) vs the frozen P_k prediction files, every level x split: top-1 identity >= 0.995 required for seed 0-2 (validates validation + compact_to_parse + execution)
identity_checks_gold_free.I1b: dev_sel2000 at every level: the frozen structural bundle parse re-executed through the SAME builder (probs='given') must reproduce the frozen structural bundle's rendered G prompt for >= 0.995 of rows (validates the bundle code path)
identity_checks_gold_free.STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT: I1a or I1b below threshold -> one logged bug-fix (amendment, before any generation), else STOP

selection_on_dev.data: dev_sel2000 ORIG (2,000; frozen G_k = its selection-time dev file; Parser = cached dev_sel2000 generation of the selected P_k checkpoint) and DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases (1,762; synthetic quid 10q+5 of the R3-track llm root; frozen G_k = its frozen variants file). Never R1, R2, R3 or test.
selection_on_dev.candidates: per level: frozen G_k (baseline), GR-A_k (PALONE), GR-K_k (PK)
selection_on_dev.criterion: admissible iff Hits@1(dev ORIG, c) - Hits@1(dev ORIG, G_k) >= -0.003 (= at most 6 of 2,000; G_k always admissible); select the admissible candidate with the highest Hits@1 on DEV_ACCEPTED; ties (|difference| < 0.0005) -> G_k, then GR-K_k, then GR-A_k (closest to the baseline first). Selecting G_k = NOT_SELECTED: no final pass and no test result at that level (reported as such). Registered before any dev number of a GR variant exists.
selection_on_dev.record: selection json (all candidate numbers with Poisson CIs, B = 10,000, seed 20261118, descriptive; I2) saved as a file BEFORE the final pass; never changed afterwards

final_pass.rows: for each level with a selected GR source: official test (54,584; GR's original-test predictions), R3 PRIMARY rewrites (578; 10q+4), R1 P3 paraphrases (569 judge-accepted; 10q+3), R2 rewrites (570 judge-accepted; 10q+3). R1 P1 (prefix) and P2 (question mark) perturbations are NOT run (mechanical, non-LLM rewordings; declared scope reduction).
final_pass.cut_order: one vLLM session, items in order: [R3 rewrites, test rows of the 578 R3 quids] for each selected level (5% first) -> [R1 P3, R2 rewrites, test rows of the R1/R2 quids] per level -> [remaining test rows] per level. Before each item: elapsed + n_generate x 0.075 s + 20 s <= budget_s else NOT_RUN (declared; a missing full-test remainder makes the full-test number unavailable and the R3/R1/R2 analyses use the probe-question test rows only)
final_pass.freeze: after the final pass every assembled prediction file (test, r3rw, r1p3, r2rw per level) and every generated file is sha256-listed in grounded_reader_freeze.json, saved as a file BEFORE the single scoring pass; the scorer verifies every hash (mismatch -> STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY)

analysis_single_pass.original_test: per selected level: Hits@1 and Hits@10 of GR_k and of frozen G_k on the full test (n = 54,584), Poisson(1) bootstrap 95% percentile CIs (r2_common.summarise, B = 10,000, seed 20261118) and the paired difference GR_k - G_k (two-sided 95% CI). Descriptive original-wording cost; reported next to the rewrite numbers; also vs the 0.3-point dev constraint (descriptive)
analysis_single_pass.R3_primary: R3 rule R3_secondary_analysis_for_method_tracks, unchanged: set = R3 PRIMARY (578) and the same questions' original text; ORIG predictions = GR_k's full-test predictions (method) and frozen G_k's full-test predictions (baseline); drop = Hits@1(ORIG) - Hits@1(R3 rewrite) per question; c_drop = drop(G_k) - drop(GR_k) (H_drop: mean > 0), c_rw = Hits@1_RW(GR_k) - Hits@1_RW(G_k) (H_rw: mean > 0); r3_common.method_tests: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap of the mean contrast, B = 10,000, seed 20261118, one-sided p = share of bootstrap means <= 0, two-sided 95% CI and one-sided 95% lower bound; Holm within this method over (selected levels) x {H_drop, H_rw} at alpha 0.05; SUPPORTED iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. NOT_SELECTED levels are not part of the family. SECONDARY robustness evidence, never the paper's primary test result.
analysis_single_pass.R1_R2: the same contrasts and statistic on R1 P3 (569) and R2 rewrites (570), ORIG = the same questions' full-test predictions; Holm within the method per probe; labelled SECONDARY (R1/R2 were analysed many times; nothing is selected on them)
analysis_single_pass.descriptive: GR_k vs P_k (Parser arm, mean over its 3 S seeds) on R3 / R1 / R2: rewrite Hits@1 difference and drop difference (summarise; not tests); assembly counts (fallback / reused / generated) per split; I1a, I1b, I2
analysis_single_pass.audit_feed: per-question R3 contrasts (c_drop, c_rw per level) written for the later single-annotator R3 audit (r3_common.audit_selection over all method tracks); this track does not run the audit

stop_rules.STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY: sha256 mismatch of a frozen input listed in expected_gr.json (exit 3) or of a frozen GR prediction at scoring
stop_rules.STOP_GPU_SHARING: one container per card; any other compute process on the card -> wait (run_card_gr.sh)

scoring_discipline: No result of this rule is changed after it is computed; anything not listed here is POST_HOC and labelled so. Test, R3, R1 and R2 hits of GR are computed once, in the registered pass, together with the frozen baseline's.
deliverables: registration rule; selection record; freeze; results json; per-question hits csv.gz; R3 per-question contrasts; report md; GPU usage log rows; code tgz
